stock.description: China Datang Corporation Renewable Power Co., Limited plays a significant role in the clean energy landscape of the People's Republic of China. Its primary business revolves around the production and distribution of electricity generated from renewable sources, particularly focusing on wind power. The company's operations extend across the full spectrum of renewable energy project development. This includes identifying opportunities, securing investments, overseeing construction, and managing facilities that harness wind, solar, hydropower, and biomass energy. Beyond power generation, it is also committed to advancing low-carbon technologies through research, development, and market promotion. Furthermore, the firm is engaged in the investigation, commercialization, testing, and upkeep of essential equipment for the renewable energy sector. Its service offerings also encompass the design, erection, installation, and ongoing maintenance and repair of power projects, both domestically and internationally. Additionally, China Datang Corporation Renewable Power facilitates the international trade of renewable energy equipment and technologies, undertakes foreign investments, and offers expert consulting services in its field. By the end of 2021, specifically December 31, the company had amassed an impressive consolidated installed capacity totaling 13,078.02 megawatts (MW). The majority of this capacity, 11,997.55 MW, was attributed to wind power, with photovoltaic (solar) installations contributing 1,075.47 MW. Originally established in 2004, the company's corporate headquarters are located in Beijing, China. It underwent a name change in March 2009, transitioning from its former identity as Datang Chifeng Saihanba Wind Power Generation Co., Ltd. to its present name. China Datang Corporation Renewable Power Co., Limited operates as a subsidiary of China Datang Corporation Ltd.

moat.method: AI qualitative assessment anchored to dated financial statements and available transcript; not a reported accounting measure

provenance.ebitda: Analyst ebitdaAvg when supplied; otherwise analyst EBIT plus modeled D&A, explicitly derived. YTD operating EBITDA is reported operating EBIT plus cash-flow D&A, not an adjusted analyst measure.
provenance.depreciation: Analyst EBITDA minus EBIT when nonnegative and both available; otherwise modeled TTM D&A/revenue. Analyst measure definitions are not independently certified.
provenance.riskFreeRate: User-directed USD Treasury proxy under the HKD/USD peg; not an observed HKD yield or a copied US-stock WACC
provenance.tax: TTM effective tax; scenario assumption, not a marginal-rate forecast
provenance.kd: TTM accounting interest / average reported debt; not a current financing quote
provenance.erp: 4.75% model assumption, not an FMP forecast
provenance.beta: FMP profile beta; lookback, frequency and benchmark unspecified by the response
provenance.terminalG: 2.25% model assumption, not an FMP forecast
provenance.cash: All reported cash and short-term investments assumed nonoperating; adjustable
provenance.investments: Long-term investments assumed nonoperating at book value; adjustable, not fair-value evidence
provenance.priority: Preferred and minority book values are adjustable value proxies; cost defaults to common Ke
provenance.leases: Cash-flow-matched debt reconciliation: liabilities whose payments remain in FCFF are not deducted again; financing treatment requires matching profit, depreciation and reinvestment adjustments
